error[L0102]: a recovery that leaves holds its `return` in a block: write `else begin return end`
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/recovery-exit-is-held-in-a-block/program.ldn:16:31
   |
16 |     found := lookup(key) else return
   |                               ^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/recovery-exit-is-held-in-a-block/program.ldn:16:26
   |
16 |     found := lookup(key) else return
   |                          ^^^^ this recovery
  = note: [1030]: `else value` stands in for the call's result, `else (problem) ... end` names the error in its block, and `try` passes the failure on instead
  = help: write `begin` before `return` and `end` after it
